title: Lombard Odier亚洲CIO：中国市场不再是简单的看多持有，需精选单家公司
speaker: John Woods

segments.en: Or some index exposure that the CSI 300 has a number of important participants and constituents but I think you have to be reasonably selective and discrete about the way that you play this because there's not one size fits all David as you know and the market isn't bifurcated in such a convenient way.
segments.zh: 或者通过指数配置，沪深300包含许多重要成分股，但我认为你必须相当有选择性和区分度，因为没有一刀切的方法，市场也不是那么简单分化的。

segments.en: Yeah you mentioned balanced exposure across onshore and offshore I mean the offshore side things has not quite played out maybe much of this year.
segments.zh: 你提到了在岸和离岸的平衡配置，离岸市场今年表现并不太好。

segments.en: What could kind of change that sort of narrative you think. We've been in a funk here. I mean because people are still questioning the monetization of AI for some of these big tech names.
segments.zh: 什么可能改变这种叙事？我们一直处于低迷状态，因为人们仍在质疑一些大型科技公司的人工智能变现能力。

segments.en: The names, the themes, the sectors we track are up 25% year to date, the broad indices are flat maybe up 2% or so. It's not a compelling buy and hold index story. I guess you might say it's more of a sector picker or stock pickers at market which is where the diamonds in the rough if you will or the opportunities are likely to be found.
segments.zh: 我们追踪的个股、主题和板块今年迄今上涨了25%，而宽基指数持平或仅上涨2%左右。这不是一个令人信服的买入并持有指数的故事。我认为这更像是一个板块选择或个股选择的市场，机会可能就在其中。

segments.en: Whether that's onshore or offshore is really down to the sector picker or the stock picker. But as I say it's much more of a discerning market now I think than a simple buy and hold directional trade that it was maybe in previous years.
segments.zh: 无论是在岸还是离岸，都取决于板块选择或个股选择。但正如我所说，现在的市场比前几年简单的买入并持有方向性交易要挑剔得多。
